plan: Validate the complete action before changing session state.
Use small helpers for session commits, prompt derivation, screen construction, and errors.
Keep console I/O behind injected source and sink objects.
mechanisms: Transactional validation prevents malformed actions from corrupting accepted session data.
A single prompt resolver keeps screen descriptions deterministic.
Copied appointment records provide ordered, isolated choice data.
Dependency injection makes run_once testable with standard-library unittest fakes.
